title: XO Silk Flower Letters, Pink & White Roses, 13" Floral Sign for Galentines, Bridal Shower or Nursery
desc:
Hugs and kisses, in full bloom. I covered this X and O in blush, hot pink, ivory and dusty-lavender silk roses and peonies. It's ready for a bridal shower backdrop, a galentines table or a sweet nursery shelf.

Size: about 20½ in wide × 13 in tall (both letters side by side, measured with the flowers)

DETAILS
• Handmade: I build every piece by hand in Fort Worth, Texas, layering silk (artificial) flowers one bloom at a time on a wood letter base, so yours is one of a kind.

• Free US shipping. Ready to ship: ships in 1–2 business days.

CARE
